title: open dependency refuses to start a task
requirement: A task whose dependsOn names a task that is not done cannot become active through task_update nor be started by delegate_task's child link: the refusal is dependency_open, it names the task it waits for, the row stays open, and the same move passes once the dependency is done. delegate_task returns that code and message instead of a generic block.
steps: Build a board with task-late (open, dependsOn ['task-deploy']) and task-deploy still active.
taskboard.update task-late -> active with role BACKEND and an owner.
taskboard.linkChild task-late with a child session.
Set task-deploy to done and repeat the update.
Run delegate_task on an open task whose update/linkChild returns dependency_open.
expected: The update and the link are refused with code dependency_open, waitingOn ['task-deploy'] and a message naming that task; the row stays open with no child; after the dependency is done the same update succeeds; delegate_task returns ok:false with code dependency_open and the dependency id in its message.
